title: A Cover for the Contact Anew
author: Emrys Lockridge
blurb: Sable Whitlock, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
